path.description: Output `.glb`, `.fbx`, `.obj`, `.stl`, `.ply`, `.usda` or `.usdz`; relative paths resolve against the project's `exports/` directory.

step.description: Grid step (1 = every sample). Default: the smallest step that keeps the mesh within `max_vertices`.

max_vertices.description: Vertex budget used when `step` is not given (default 1025² = 1 050 625).

texture.description: Embed a baked base-colour texture (hypsometric ramp + slope, one texel per vertex).

target_triangles.description:
Decimate the sampled grid to at most this many triangles (quadric edge collapse):
flat ground collapses, ridges keep their detail. Not for `.fbx`.

lods.description:
Also write this many coarser levels beside the file (`<stem>_lod1.<ext>`, …), each with
a quarter of the previous level's triangles; the report lists them under `lods`. 1..=8, not for `.fbx`.
